title: The tin, hers
logline: A new pushpin tin on Gully's counter beside the rusted one, and the girl's hand, sixteen, putting the old one in a drawer. The page keeps the drawer open.

panels.composition: A shop counter with a new pushpin tin on it and a teenage girl's hand placing the old rusted tin into an open drawer beneath the counter.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a shop counter with a new pushpin tin on it and a teenage girl's hand placing an old rusted tin into an open drawer beneath, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
